reason: Infection defines this broad umbrella; vascular and blood-cell involvement vary across pathogens and do not justify additional axes across the group.
The optic nerve belongs to ocular under this guide. Anti-MOG autoimmunity warrants infectious_immune; isolated optic neuritis does not establish additional neurologic involvement.

Progressive encephalopathy and brainstem degeneration define neurologic disease. Vomiting and centrally mediated sensory findings do not establish damage to other organs; leukodystrophy alone does not establish a metabolic disorder.
B-cell malignancy supports haematologic, and lymphoma requires infectious_immune. Breast is outside the anatomical axes; the integumentary parent does not establish skin involvement.

Marrow lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma supports haematologic and infectious_immune. The metabolic parent is clinically misleading; respiratory insufficiency does not establish direct pulmonary damage, and infiltrates are occasional.

Neurodevelopmental impairment defines the syndrome. Myopia in 6/12 and strabismus in 4/12 support ocular involvement; congenital cardiac defects occur in about half. Hearing impairment in 3/12 is below threshold.

Immunodeficiency, destructive pulmonary disease and inflammatory gastrointestinal disease are defining features. Immune dysfunction alone does not require haematologic; the remaining findings do not establish another common directly damaged organ.
Autoimmunity and cutaneous disease characterize the lupus umbrella. Systemic lupus frequencies cannot automatically establish joint, blood or renal involvement across skin-limited and systemic forms.

Fanconi marrow disease warrants haematologic. Microcephaly alone does not establish neurologic dysfunction; anal atresia is below 30%, pigment spots do not establish damage, and predisposed cancers are separate diseases.

Cerebral destruction defines neurologic disease. Frequent pituitary atrophy and very frequent sensorineural hearing impairment support the involved axes. Cortical blindness does not establish ocular damage; arterial findings may reflect the initiating vascular disruption.
